articles.title: Tarun Garg takes over as MD & CEO of Hyundai Motor India
articles.summary: Hyundai Motor India Ltd has announced that Tarun Garg will take over as its Managing Director & CEO starting January 1, 2026. This appointment is noteworthy, marking the first time a senior professional has assumed this top leadership role at the company. This signifies a key leadership transition in India's automotive sector, impacting national business dynamics and potentially setting new precedents for corporate leadership.

articles.title: Zelensky says deal to end war '10 percent' away
articles.summary: Ukrainian President Zelensky stated Ukraine is "10 percent" away from a peace deal with Russia, though he cautioned that the most critical issues remain unresolved. This indicates ongoing, albeit complex, diplomatic efforts to end the conflict. Aspirants should observe how international negotiations proceed amidst active warfare, highlighting the significant hurdles in achieving a lasting resolution and the cautious optimism expressed by Ukraine.

articles.title: China and Taiwan’s ‘reunification’ will not be stopped, Xi Jinping vows in New Year’s speech
articles.summary: Taiwan remains on high alert after China staged massive military drills around the island on Tuesday. Taiwan's emergency maritime response centre is actively monitoring Chinese naval movements, underscoring ongoing vigilance. These aggressive drills heighten cross-strait tensions and highlight persistent geopolitical challenges in the Indo-Pacific, a critical region for global stability and strategic interests.
